svg.title: Service engagement staff and time evidence
svg.desc: Service engagement staff and time evidence. An engagement leads to assignments and time entries. Employee records support both assignments and time. Keep the record grains separate. Foreign-key paths, analytical matches, and business context answer different questions; read the numbered evidence table before joining.
